verdict.summary: The bounded max-parallel settings preserve both complete nightly matrices and fail-fast:false while limiting their concurrent hosted-runner admissions. The audit consistently accounts for capped matrix legs and plain jobs, enforces per-lane and combined ceilings, rejects critical-path triggers, verifies Miri partition coverage, and is wired into docs-quality. Its fixture, live-workflow, and mutation tests exercise the real audit path and are non-vacuous. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is evident. Round 8 is materially unchanged from round 7, with no findings in either round.
